title: golden-query-set.v1
description: An operator-supplied set of queries for comparing a store with its re-embedded rebuild. A set read from a file is always operator-selected, whatever it says about itself, so a comparison run against it reports in full and can never move a lock-in score. Only a set this tool drew by seed can do that, and such a set is never written to a file.

mode.description: record_anchored: each named record's own stored vector is the query in both stores, so neither model is needed at query time. text: free-text queries embedded by each store's own model, which needs both models to be built-in schemes this package implements.

description.description: Free text for the operator's own use. Never read as a claim about the set.

anchors.description: Record identifiers, for record_anchored mode only. An identifier absent from either store is counted in queries_skipped rather than failing the run.

queries.description: Free-text queries, for text mode only.

expected_records.description: The records this query should retrieve. Operator-declared, so hit rate and MRR computed from them are attested in exactly the way the set is. When every query omits them the comparison is agreement only.
